name: Tam
self_text: Hi! I'm Tam, a Brazilian in my early 30s. When I'm not gaming, I spend my time on urban gardening because I love bringing a bit of nature into the city. I play on a handheld and I'm currently into Hollow Lantern. I'm looking to jump into some ranked matches, but I'm specifically looking for someone to coach me. In terms of communication, I use text chat only. I'm usually available to play on Saturday mornings or Sunday afternoons. I'm really excited to get better at the game and see how far I can climb!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into ranked matches and you have to be the one who coaches me. I'd strongly prefer that we overlap on text chat, though it's not a requirement. It would be nice if you are available Saturday morning or Sunday afternoon, and a small bonus if you are into Skyforge Arena.
